description: Provide first-hand or well-substantiated operational insights and lessons learned on Loitering Munitions and UCAS, particularly from the Ukrainian conflict. Contributions include structured recommendations, questionnaires, interviews and participation in a D-STORM workshop. These inputs will inform the consortium's work on use cases, scenarios, concepts of operations (CONOPS) and high-level requirements.
